purpose: Teach: 車種/日本円/丸の内/新橋/読み物/スチール/ストリーム/ポータブル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社用車の車種選定を見直せ
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. Formal register. Direct eye contact. No warmth, no hesitation—this is a mandate, not a question. Measured pace, slight weight on the verb.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外取引の日本円換算を厳しく管理します
lines.en: Understood. I'll tighten our management of yen conversion on overseas transactions.
lines.style: Businesslike confirmation. Respectful but not obsequious. Slightly faster pace—eager to show he's already thinking through the execution. Clear enunciation on the numbers.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、丸の内のオフィスへの移転を検討しろ
lines.en: Look into relocating our office to Marunouchi.
lines.style: Same clipped authority as the first line. Lean forward slightly in posture. No inflection that invites discussion—this is assignment, not suggestion. Steady, commanding tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新橋の取引先との会合を設定します
lines.en: Understood. I'll arrange a meeting with our Shinbashi clients.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Pen already moving—he's tracking tasks as they come. Brisk, efficient rhythm. Slight nod embedded in the delivery. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内向け読み物を充実させろ
lines.style: Same commanding register. Slight pause before the verb—deliberate emphasis. This is non-negotiable. Cool, measured authority. The kind of directive that carries weight because it's stated simply.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場のスチール棚を増設します
lines.en: Understood. I'll add more steel shelving to the warehouse.
lines.style: Rapid, efficient confirmation. He's already moved on mentally to the next task. Short, clipped phrases. Professional shorthand—no need for elaboration between them.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、配信ストリームの品質を上げろ
lines.en: Improve the quality of our streaming output.
lines.style: Final directive. Slightly firmer jaw. Direct gaze. The tone says this is not a suggestion but a concrete expectation. Steady, unhurried pace. Weight on 'quality.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ポータブル機器の充電体制を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll establish a charging system for our portable devices.
lines.style: Final confirmation—slight shift in tempo, almost a closing rhythm. Efficient, clear. A small nod of finality. He's absorbed all the tasks, ready to move. No trailing off.
